test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following highways covers most of Rajasthan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**NH 15​.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Highway-15** covers most of Rajasthan.
 
• The longest national highway in **Rajasthan that joins the state to the Kandla port of Gujarat** is **NH-15.**
 
• Aside from NH-15, the other highway that joins Rajasthan state to the Kandla port of Gujarat is NH-14.
 
• National Highway 15 begins from **Baihata in Assam and terminates at Wakro in Arunachal Pradesh**, while traversing between** Mangaldai, Dhekiajuli, Tezpur, Banderdeva, North Lakhimpur, Kulajan, Dibrugarh, Tinsukia, Rupai and Mahadevpur.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• National Highway 8 (NH 8) is **a National Highway in India running from Karimganj in Assam to Sabroom in Tripura.**
 
• **National Highway 7 **(NH 7) is **a highway connecting Fazilka (Punjab) to Mana (Uttarakhand) in India.**
 
• **National Highway 47** (NH 47) is the main National Highway in India, It starts from **Bamanbore in Gujarat and terminates at Nagpur in Maharashtra.****​ **
